description.narrative: The Khatlon Energy Loss Reduction Project will include billing and metering equipment installation and distribution network upgrades (modernisation of the low voltage grid / substation infrastructure) in the cities of Bokhtar and Kulob in the Khatlon Province of Tajikistan. The main objective of the Project is to improve reliability, energy efficiency and financial sustainability of the electricity networks in the cities of Bokhtar and Kulob in the Khatlon province of Tajikistan.
